description: North Western Provincial Council - Notify the North Western Provincial Rural Development Statute, No. 04 of 2017
categorisation: The gazette content announces the enactment of the "North Western Provincial Rural Development Statute No. 04 of 2017," which is a provincial law establishing a new Department of Rural Development and creating regulatory frameworks for rural development societies and boards. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the creation of new legislation, statutory instruments, and regulatory frameworks for rural development in the province.
